2.name: TRIGER#
2.hint: comparator input: below 1/3 of V+ (VTRIG 0.4–0.6 V at 1.5 V) it sets the flip-flop – the output goes high and DIS lets go (8.3); trigger current 10 pA typ

3.name: OUTPUT
3.hint: push-pull: VOH ≥ 1.0 V at −0.25 mA and VOL ≤ 0.4 V at 1 mA with V+ 1.5 V, VOH ≥ 4.4 V at −2 mA and VOL ≤ 0.6 V at 8 mA with 5 V (6.5) – a weak source at low supply: about 2 kΩ high, 400 Ω low at 1.5 V

4.name: RESET#
4.hint: active low: tie it to V+ when unused, against false triggering (pin functions, p. 3); VRES 0.4–1.0 V at 1.5 V, 0.4–1.1 V at 12 V (6.5)

5.name: CV
5.hint: control voltage: the 2/3 V+ point of the internal divider (VCTRL 0.8–1.2 V at 1.5 V, 2.9–3.8 V at 5 V, 6.5); the layout example bypasses it with 0.01 µF (11.2, C2)

6.name: TH
6.hint: comparator input: above 2/3 of V+ (the CV voltage) it resets the flip-flop – the output goes low and DIS pulls down (8.3); threshold current 10 pA typ

7.name: DC
7.hint: discharge: open drain, low in phase with the output (pin functions, p. 3); VDIS ≤ 150 mV at 1 mA with V+ 1.5 V, ≤ 300 mV at 10 mA with 5 V (6.5) – about 150 Ω and 30 Ω; leakage ≤ 100 nA at 12 V
